issues.issue: Whether State protection would be available to the principal claimant against her former partner
issues.applicant_position: Says police never helped her and she did not approach them; State protection is not adequate in Saint Vincent.
issues.result_quote: The panel finds that she did not provide the clear and convincing evidence necessary to do so.

issues.issue: Whether the daughter has a well-founded fear of her former partner
issues.applicant_position: Fears her former partner, who she says threatened to kill her and abused her; relies on past abuse and threats.
issues.result_quote: the panel finds that XXXX does not have a well-founded fear of persecution of XXXX XXXX

issues.issue: Whether State protection is available to the minor children against the grandfather's abuse
issues.applicant_position: Mother fears the grandfather will harm her daughters; says he sexually abused the older girl and no report was made.
issues.result_quote: The panel finds that, in the case of XXXX and the two minor claimants, State protection would be available to them.

issues.applicant_position: Claims a risk to life, cruel treatment or torture if returned to Saint Vincent.
